prediction_text: No — he shall NOT obtain the parsonage. The testimonies are all negative and Lilly enumerates them: Saturn impedited in the Ascendant infortunes the question; Jupiter, lord of the 9th (the benefice), is in no aspect with the lord of the Ascendant, nor is the Moon in any aspect with either; neither the lord of the Ascendant nor the Moon is placed in the 9th; there is no translation or collection of light and no reception between the significators; the Moon separates from a trine and applies to an opposition of Mercury, lord of the 3rd (opposition and ill report work against him); Venus in the 7th opposes the Ascendant. With no application, no reception and no translation, there is no perfection — the suit fails, however pressed.
basis: tradition: horary（卡面载明）。systems_used: horary。已载面：能否得教职（主问）。断项过闸：不得←象征星间无相位、无接纳、无传光集光（原文七项否定证词逐项在卡）＋升内土星受损蚀问。对象核：承受=求问者，应验同一。此为单一成败问、无应期可取（不成则无成期），应期条注明不适用之由：无成相之路。
